from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
import numpy as np
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L').filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(2))

# also color overlay
rgb=np.stack([np.asarray(Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L'))]*3,-1).astype(np.float32)
m=d>0.35
rgb[...,0]=np.where(m,255,rgb[...,0])
rgb[...,1]=np.where(m,np.minimum(rgb[...,1],80),rgb[...,1])
rgb[...,2]=np.where(m,np.minimum(rgb[...,2],80),rgb[...,2])
Image.fromarray(rgb.astype(np.uint8)).save('overlay.png')
print('done', (d>0.35).mean())
"", "description": "Build radiolucency map via background subtraction"}
